lines: Hmmm, the large box turns out to be locked.
Agnes the Hatamoto            St:15 Dx:17 Co:18 In:9 Wi:7 Ch:10 Lawful

notes: Hero: lawful human Samurai, XL 1, turn 2, Dlvl 1, wielding a +0 katana; also a +0 wakizashi (short sword), yumi, ya, splint mail, blindfold. No key, lock pick, credit card, wand or tool that unlocks.
The hero stands on a large box; #loot just said "Hmmm, the large box turns out to be locked." Pet little dog nearby.
